existing_dashboard_modification: The technology row held twenty-five controls: the spine's five tabs plus one tab per wider-fleet REPD technology type. Nine of those twenty types hold five rows or fewer and one holds a single row, and on a phone they pushed the spine's own four tabs several wrapped lines down. This replaces the twenty appended buttons with one <label> + <select> in the same row: same payload, same filter, same table render, same MAP link and the same REPD reference carried through. The spine's five tabs are not touched. Neither appended node carries .btn, so the spine's `#tech .btn` handler still cannot see them. The select has a 44px minimum height at every width and cannot widen the row past its container. The twenty are now reachable by ?technology=<REPD type name>, which the spine's five-member whitelist had always coerced to 'all'; the cartridge reads it after mount, and writes the chosen name back with history.replaceState.
